name: codex-workflow-guardian
description: macOS-only explicit Codex workflow for bounded intake, receipt-backed routing, recovery, and separate acceptance evidence.

interface.longDescription: macOS-only explicit Codex workflow for bounded delivery and acceptance, with optional All in Luna durable runs, a strictly read-only sanitized Reconciler, and receipt-backed Setup. No MCP, credentials, or private OMC. Distributed through this GitHub-backed repo marketplace, not the universal Plugins Directory.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-workflow-guardian explicitly for delivery; source, tests, capability, installed, and live evidence stay separate.
Use $reconcile-codex-subagents for a strictly read-only sanitized before/after check.
Use $setup-codex-workflow-guardian to check or explicitly apply the immutable dependency lock.
